scope: Consistency of local Codex and Agy JSONL token counters used by the development runner and observer

false_green_before_fix.codex: input_tokens 10, cached_input_tokens 11, output_tokens 2, reasoning_output_tokens 3 were reported complete with no errors
false_green_before_fix.agy: input_tokens 10, cache_read_tokens 11, output_tokens 2, thinking_tokens 3, total_tokens 12, with matching DONE step and SUCCESS result, were reported complete with no errors

post_fix_checks: cached input or cache read tokens must not exceed input tokens
reasoning output or thinking tokens must not exceed output tokens
Agy DONE agent_response steps and final usage are checked separately
equal subset and parent counts remain valid
an impossible usage report retains terminal_success when the terminal event succeeded but has complete false and explicit errors
the raw JSONL trace remains unchanged

checks.command: uv run --no-sync ruff check scripts/run_development_arm.py tests/test_run_development_arm.py

independent_review.verdict: no material reproducible false green found in the bounded review
independent_review.reviewer: native read-only development agent, not an authenticated telemetry custodian

limitations: The JSONL is a local CLI claim, not an authenticated provider receipt.
Arithmetic consistency does not prove complete billing, a strict pre-call token cutoff, or equal access and budgets across methods.
The fixtures are synthetic and do not establish any comparative advantage.
